assay: bulk RNA-seq (polyA, paired-end, NovaSeq 6000), abdominal subcutaneous adipose tissue, human
samples: 45 regular exercisers, one session each of LOW (n=15), MOD (n=15) or HIGH (n=15); aSAT biopsy Pre and 1.5 h post-exercise (90 libraries)
primary_estimand: within-group paired Post vs Pre change in aSAT gene expression for each exercise intensity, and between-intensity differences in that change
planned_contrasts: LOW post vs pre (S3.3.p1; paper: 1003 DEGs, 397 up / 606 down)
MOD post vs pre (S3.3.p1; paper: 1979 DEGs, 773 up / 1206 down)
HIGH post vs pre (S3.3.p1; paper: 759 DEGs, 452 up / 307 down)
HIGH vs MOD change (S3.3.p2; paper: 734 DEGs)
HIGH vs LOW change (S3.3.p2; paper: 183 DEGs)
MOD vs LOW change (S3.3.p2; paper: 0 DEGs)
paper_method: DESeq2, ~ group + group:ID + group:condition, Wald tests, median-of-ratios, genes kept with >=10 counts in >=15 samples (17,466 genes)
paper_enrichment: CAMERA (limma) on GO/KEGG/Hallmark with signed log p, BH < 0.05
